target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Focuses on workforce development and business resources in Ashtabula County. Partners with LEADERship Ashtabula County and The Computer Workshop to deliver leadership training courses. Offers member discounts (25% off) on professional development: Business Communications, Dealing with Conflict and Difficult People, Teamwork and Team Building, Communication Strategies. Resource Pro platform would help manage business assistance programs, workforce initiatives, and training resource allocation.

target_buyer_2.leadership: Patrick J. Arcaro, Executive Director (since September 2004)
target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: All-in-one workforce resource center providing job training and workforce development services under Ashtabula County Job and Family Services. Mission: 'Provide superior service, promote well-being and self-sufficiency, alleviate conditions of poverty, and improve health and safety.' Patrick J. Arcaro has bachelor's in Political Science (Gannon University) and master's in Public Administration with Healthcare Administration Certificate (Cleveland State). Serves on several local, county and State Boards. Resource management platform would help track client resources, training programs, and service allocation.
